rationale: Finding: 'Slight discoloration on hydraulic fluid, but within operating viscosity limits.' (Normal wear, does not require a WO).
Finding: 'Thermal scan shows phase B terminal is 40C hotter than A and C.' (Asymmetric heat on 3-phase power is a critical failure indicator).
Finding: 'Vibration up 0.1 mm/s from baseline, still well within normal tolerance zone.' (Trend is slightly up but strictly normal, flag to monitor, no WO).
Finding: 'Metal shavings found in gearbox oil sample.' (Metal in oil means active destructive wear, urgent WO needed).
